Small excerpts of real responses, cut on 2026-10-11, so the space-ledger tests run without network access.

- `satcat.csv`, `gp_decaying.json`, `gp_stations.json`: CelesTrak (celestrak.org)
- `gcat_satcat.tsv`, `gcat_orgs.tsv`: data from GCAT (J. McDowell, planet4589.org/space/gcat), CC-BY-4.0
- `ll2_previous.json`: Launch Library 2 (The Space Devs), trimmed to the fields the parser reads
